summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with GOWell Technology Limited, terminating all post-closing transfer restrictions for sponsors and representatives. The third amendment removes the covenant requiring Sponsors to enter into Lock-Up Agreements, effectively lifting share transfer restrictions. This action modifies the previously announced SPAC merger terms, signaling a change in deal structure rather than a full termination. The filing notes prior amendments in December 2025 and July 2026, indicating ongoing negotiations. What to watch: whether further amendments or termination occur, and the impact on deal completion and sponsor incentives.
